name: xsec-vscode
description: Catch and auto-fix security vulnerabilities in AI-written code, live as you type. Python, JS/TS & Java.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted folders XSEC will not run, because it executes the configured 'xsec' program. Trust the folder to enable scanning.

xsec.enable.description: Master switch. When off, XSEC does no scanning at all.

xsec.executable.markdownDescription: Path to the xsec CLI. Defaults to `xsec` on your PATH. **Machine-scoped**: a project's `.vscode/settings.json` cannot change this, so opening someone else's repo can't redirect XSEC to a malicious binary.

xsec.scanOnSave.description: Scan a file automatically when it is saved. Turn off to scan only via the commands.

xsec.enableAI.markdownDescription: **Sends file contents to Anthropic's API** for AI review (`--ai`). Off by default; everything runs locally and offline unless you turn this on. Needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in your environment.

xsec.enableAutofix.description: Allow XSEC to rewrite files when you use the auto-fix action. Turn off if you want scanning only, never edits.

xsec.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended to every xsec scan invocation. **Machine-scoped** so a repo cannot inject its own arguments.
